submission.justification: After systematic simulation studies, Absorber-F2 with 6mm plate thickness delivers the best energy resolution of 3.04% at 100 GeV. This represents a clear optimum: resolution degrades for both thinner plates (3.79% at 2mm due to insufficient sampling) and thicker plates (4.59% at 10mm due to increased shower fluctuations). The configuration achieves 38% better resolution than Absorber-F1 and 21% better than Absorber-F3's best performance, while satisfying all safety and operational constraints. The 6mm thickness balances optimal sampling frequency with minimal shower fluctuations for F2's short radiation length material properties.
